page_title: WER 0-0 DOR | Werder Bremen v Dortmund 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+4' That didn't go as planned! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Michael Zetterer, who easily kept it out.
90+3' Emre Can (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Marvin Ducksch.

90' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.
85' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Justin Njinmah walks off the pitch to be replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
80' The total number of attempts is 5:8.
77' Nuri Sahin decides to make a substitution. Julian Brandt will be replaced by Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
73' This was really stupid from Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Robert Hartmann.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is coming onto the pitch as Maximilian Beier cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
67' The free kick from long range, taken by Werder Bremen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' The ball is cleared after Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.

63' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner, but Michael Zetterer pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
63' Dortmund have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
61' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
59' The corner kick from Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
59' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
59' A snap shot by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Michael Zetterer produces a good save to thwart him.
57' Here is a change. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens is going off and Nuri Sahin gives the last tactical orders to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
57' Substitution. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) in, Niklas Sule out.
55' The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
55' Here's the latest number of offsides – 6:1.
53' The booking goes to Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund).
52' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
50' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
49' Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
48' Robert Hartmann interrupts the game. One of the players from Dortmund won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Werder Bremen will take a free kick near the side line.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' That was close by Julian Brandt (Dortmund)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
43' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
41' The referee is firm and issues Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) a deserved yellow card.
41' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
40' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Werder Bremen was in an offside position.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Felix Agu (Werder Bremen).
38' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
36' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes it short.
36' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
34' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) is booked by the referee.
33' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

30' Emre Can (Dortmund) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Hartmann with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
29' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
27' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
26' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
24' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is cleared by the defence.
22' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
18' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' The current number of offsides is 2:1.
12' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
11' Werder Bremen are ruled offside.
10' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
9' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' The ball has crossed the sideline. Werder Bremen are taking a throw-in.
6' Werder Bremen couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
6' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick.
4' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Robert Hartmann will officiate today.
